title: Delivered code documented the premise the change was made to refute
trigger: L2 verifier gate on P-002 returned REJECT
description: The chain-experiment runner's module docstring asserted that depth.divergence 'accumulates along the chain and grows monotonically for genuinely-altering chains'. P-002 was specifically the change that refuted this premise: divergence is a distance from the baseline world, so an intervention restoring a canonical value lowers it (Verrin depths 1-3 score 26 / 25 / 26). The false claim survived in the docstring of the very module that produces those numbers, contradicting docs/ARCHITECTURE-RECONNAISSANCE.md section 8.1(b), src/depth/types.ts, and both acceptance test files.
root_cause: The experiment-runner lane was dispatched in parallel with the depth-metrics lane and wrote its docstring against the ORIGINAL (incorrect) divergence semantics stated in its own task brief. When the orchestrator later discovered the metric defect and dispatched a remediation lane, that lane's scope was defined as the metric plus its tests; prose in a sibling module that encoded the same false premise was not enumerated in the remediation scope. Root cause is therefore an incomplete blast-radius analysis by the orchestrator when scoping the fix: the defect class was 'the refuted premise is asserted somewhere', but the fix scope was written as a file list rather than as a repo-wide claim search.
corrective_action: Docstring corrected in commit 0e009d2 to state that divergence is a distance and does NOT grow monotonically, citing the 26/25/26 evidence and referencing section 8.1(b). Re-verification gate instructed to grep the entire src/ tree and the design document for any surviving monotonicity claim rather than checking only the reported line.
preventive_action: When a change refutes a previously-documented premise, the remediation scope must include a repo-wide search for assertions of that premise (code comments, docstrings, tests, design docs), not just the files implementing the corrected behaviour. Verifier briefs should ask for the claim search explicitly.
notes: No functional defect: 138/138 tests, tsc clean, verify-facts 3/3 at the time of REJECT. The gate correctly refused to admit 'the code is right, the doc in it is wrong' on the exact axis the change corrected.
